facts.fact: Algérie Télécom's presentation to the ITU says that with its data centres it offers cloud services, connectivity and data security to outside customers.

DZA.note: The document states nothing about a government data exchange platform.
Only bilateral point-to-point peering with Algérie Télécom is described, not an exchange point where networks meet.

facts.fact: Algérie Télécom says its network links Algeria abroad through the SeaMeWe4, MEDEX, ORVAL/ALVAL and MAREA submarine cables and through land cables to neighbouring countries such as Tunisia.
facts.system: SeaMeWe4, MEDEX, ORVAL/ALVAL, MAREA, terrestrial link to Tunisia

DZA.note: The document does not state who owns Algérie Télécom's data centres or any hosting of government data.
